detail.longDescription: Hi, Bruno here, creator of DomainPuff. Just launched this and would be awesome to have your feedback on it. Just put your business idea on the search box and your budget. It will find memorable domain names that are currently available and within your budget, with the link to acquire the domain if desired. So now you don't have to go back and forth from ChatGPT to NameCheap to find a domain for your next venture. Cheers!
